scripts.test:chrome: npm run prereport && cypress run --browser chrome
scripts.test:all: npm run prereport && cypress run --browser chrome
scripts.test:headed: npm run prereport && cypress run --headed --browser chrome
scripts.test:headless: npm run prereport && cypress run --browser chrome
scripts.test:smoke: npm run prereport && cypress run --browser chrome --expose grepTags="@smoke",grepFilterSpecs=true
scripts.test:smoke:mobile: npm run prereport && cypress run --browser chrome --spec 'cypress/e2e/gui/**/*' --config viewportWidth=375,viewportHeight=812 --expose grepTags="@smoke",grepFilterSpecs=true
scripts.test:regression: npm run prereport && cypress run --browser chrome
scripts.test:lighthouse: npm run prereport && cypress run --browser chrome --config specPattern='cypress/lighthouse/**/*.cy.js'
scripts.test:visual:update: rm -rf cypress/visual/cypress-image-diff-screenshots/baseline && VISUAL_UPDATE=1 cypress run --browser chrome --config-file cypress.visual.config.js
scripts.generate:report: npm run merge:reports && npm run create:html
